name: Validation
question: Will people adopt this solution and keep using it?
binding_constraint: proof that a niche wants the thing badly, and keeps using it

gate.name: Product-market fit: retention holds
asks: Do people in the niche adopt the solution without being pushed?
Do the people who start using it keep using it?
Will they pay, or show another cost that proves they want it?

evidence.statement: A solution record tested with the niche
A product-market fit record whose evidence shows the niche keeps using the product
A pricing record with what people paid or committed

weights.note: Unvalidated priors, ours: how much each function's open decisions count when decisions are ranked across functions in this phase. They sum to 1. The decision queue ranks with them (packages/naive/src/engine/decision-queue.ts, EE-127).

strategy.why: Keeps the niche narrow while the evidence comes in

products.why: The product is what adoption and retention are measured on

marketing-and-sales.why: Reaching the niche and finding out whether it pays

supply-chain.why: Nothing is bought at volume yet

customer-service.why: Early users' feedback and problems are the retention signal

finance.why: Runway against the time the proof takes

risk-and-compliance.why: Terms and privacy for the first real users

capabilities.why: Learning loops on interviews and feedback
